2. SPORTS CHARACTERS: football players (pads/uniform), basketball players, baseball players — 3D models or at minimum full outfit part sets (jerseys, helmets, pads, gloves).

WHERE TO DIG: OpenGameArt.org deep keyword search (vampire/dracula/nosferatu/baseball/football/basketball/jersey/helmet/sports — 3D art AND collections, paginate); Sketchfab downloadable + CC license search; Kenney.nl full catalog; Quaternius full catalog; itch.io free 3D assets with CC0/CC-BY; Poly Pizza search. LICENSE: CC0 or CC-BY (or equivalent permissive) ONLY. NO GPL/AGPL, NO Mixamo/Adobe-restricted, NO non-commercial. Verify from source page per pack.

DELIVERABLE: download, stage in ~/workspace/street-brawl-cicd/game/assets/staging/parts/<pack>/ with LICENSE note, log it, update docs/PART_ATTACH_SPEC.md. If something truly doesn't exist after honest deep search, document exactly where you looked.

INVIOLABLE: painted multi-piece textures (tint-multiply look law); IP rule — inspired-by archetypes only, never copy named characters.
